verdicts.evidence: Paragraph 1 says "between early morning and late evening" and "a little longer when the tide turns against the boat", and paragraph 3 says "In winter" and "leaves the quay before dusk"; no clock times, months or delay figure appear anywhere.
Paragraph 3 says "Printed timetables are kept in the shelter at each landing", and the page has no timetable or table of departures.
Under the single heading are four unlabelled paragraphs about the schedule, bicycles, winter service and the landing stages, with no subheads.
